Rudyard Kipling, Captains Courageous.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/rudyard-kipling/captains-courageous

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Rudyard Kipling, the author, died 1936 (Wikidata Q34743, P570 = 1936-01-18).

First publication of the text used: 1897 (SE colophon: 'Captains Courageous was published in 1897 by Rudyard Kipling.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1897, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1992.
- Country of origin: the facts do not establish the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or shorter for these deaths. The last person named above died in 1936, so the text has been public domain in each of them since 1 January 2007.
